movement_profile.footwork: Heel and toe strikes against the floor.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo or team square dance formations.

signature_moves.description: A forward and backward brush of the foot.
signature_moves.name: Shuffle

music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced fiddle and banjo melodies providing a steady, driving rhythm for percussive footwork.

basic_steps: Shuffle: A quick forward and backward brush of the foot.
Heel strike: Striking the heel against the floor on the downbeat.
Toe strike: Striking the toe against the floor.
teaching.formation: Solo or team square dance formation.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on keeping the upper body still while maintaining a consistent rhythm with the heels.
